incident.description: tau#331 repair worktree held 2 unmerged commits from a dead dispatch (Aug 29); registry.py refused with 'merge or delete the branch first' and every */5 cron tick emitted an identical BLOCKED receipt (15+ consecutive) instead of composing ops-worktrees archive. Resolved manually: commits recovered via reflog cherry-pick, landed on tau main as 468745db2+588e5171c, tau#331 closed, worktree removed.

fail_before_fix.rationale: Before the #1589 fix, registry.py's unmerged-refusal path names no ops-worktrees archive composition, so this grep proof fails. Once the fix lands, the retained agentic_eval.json case must seed an unmerged worktree, run a tick, and read back an archive receipt with a verified restorable bundle.

regressions.repair_revision: issue #1589 (open; incident resolved manually, guard pending fix)

incident.description: While a human-driven recovery rebase was mid-flight in repair-worktrees/tau-331, a watchdog dispatch reset watchdog/issue-331 to origin/main (reflog: 'branch: Reset to origin/main'), orphaning commits 1f6a51a25/575e16905. During an active rebase HEAD is detached, so the origin/main..HEAD unmerged guard saw nothing to protect. Work was recovered from reflog and landed.

fail_before_fix.rationale: registry.py's leftover-worktree guard checks only origin/main..HEAD, which is blind during an in-progress rebase/cherry-pick (detached HEAD). Until the guard also refuses when .git/rebase-merge, rebase-apply, MERGE_HEAD, or CHERRY_PICK_HEAD exists in the worktree, a dispatch can destroy live recovery work. The retained case must seed a worktree mid-rebase and assert the dispatch refuses without resetting the branch.
